Video Space Original Starter Library — 2026

Scope: original synthetic WAV audio under assets/sounds and assets/music;
original SVG/PNG sticker artwork under assets/stickers; editable text template
recipes in manifest.json; generate.py and render_stickers.cjs.

Author: Video Space Lab (original procedural collection).

To the extent copyright or related rights exist in these original resources,
the author dedicates them to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal, with the
public-license fallback provided by that instrument. You may use, edit and
redistribute these resources, including in commercial videos, without an
attribution requirement. No trademark rights or endorsement are granted.

License: CC0-1.0
Canonical instrument: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Full legal text: CC0-1.0.txt

Excluded: font files, font metadata and font notices under assets/fonts. These
are unmodified upstream files, each distributed under the SIL Open Font License
1.1 alongside its own OFL.txt notice. The rest of the Video Space application
and its upstream dependencies are also outside the scope of this dedication.

The collection uses no CapCut-owned assets, stock recordings, sampled songs,
voice recordings or scraped editing packs. The procedural sources are retained
for reproducibility and modification. This library is supplied as-is.
